description: What we observed when we ran products ourselves. Search by task words, product id or result (passed_in_this_test, partial_in_this_test, failed_in_this_test, not_tested, not_available_on_tested_plan, observation). Each result applies to the product as it was on run_date, on the plan stated; a later version inherits nothing.

cursor.description: Offset for the next page: 0 for the first page, then the next_cursor value from the previous result.
cursor.title: Cursor

detail.description: true to include the full claim_checks and exit_test blocks of up to 3 sessions (large); default false.
detail.title: Detail

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50 (default 10, to keep the answer small).
limit.title: Limit

product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Leave empty for all products.
product_id.title: Product Id

query.description: Task words to search our hands-on test results, e.g. 'export contacts'. Leave empty to list all.
query.title: Query

result.description: Only return results with this outcome.
result.title: Result

name: get_task_evidence
